title:
Planned with IT leaders,
felt by every employee.
subtitle: A Microsoft project lands differently on every role. We answer to all four.

personas.title: Migrations that don’t slip
personas.description: Your team already has a day job. We take the Microsoft project off their desk and hand your engineers a plan to review, so nobody is running a second job at night or carrying the risk alone.
personas.alt: IT leadership planning a Microsoft 365 migration

personas.title:
The deal timetable,
not the IT timetable.
personas.description: The people running the deal need a date they can hold. We work to the integration timetable your legal and finance leads set, and say early when a system will not make it.
personas.alt: M&A integration team planning a tenant migration to a Day-1 deadline

personas.title:
One system.
One set of numbers.
personas.description: Dynamics 365 — Business Central or Finance & Operations — with Power BI on top, so the month-end number in the board pack is the one in the ledger.
personas.alt: Finance and operations lead reviewing Dynamics 365 reporting

personas.title:
Log in Monday,
find your work waiting.
personas.description: Your files, Teams channels and calendar arrive where people expect them, and everyone hears what is changing before it changes rather than on the morning it does.
personas.alt: Employee working in Microsoft 365 the morning after cutover
